senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. מוּךְ)to crush; to dissolve by rubbing.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>מָעֲכוּ את הזקן</he> (<cite ref="P00342"><he>העיר</he></cite>) they crushed an old man to death.
Tosef. Pes. IV, 3, v. infra.—Part. pass. מָעוּךְ; f. מְעוּכָה; pl. מְעוּכִים, מְעוּכִין; מְעוּכוֹת dissolved by rubbing, crushed.
<cite ref="Niddah 22b:19">Nidd. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ע״י הדחק</he> a foetus which can be squashed by rubbing, although with some difficulty.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:5:3">Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵈ</cite> top <he>מ׳ חיבור</he> a substance pressed into a mass (as olives in the vat) is considered as connected, v. <cite ref="H00658"><he>חִיבּוּר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 73">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIII, 4</cite> <he>מעוכה</he> ed. Bub., v. <cite ref="S00810"><he>קָטַף</he></cite>.—Lam. R. l. c. <he>פסח מעוכין</he> (not <he>מעוכן</he>) the Passover of the crushed (crowded); <cite ref="Pesachim 64b:8">Pes. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>שנתמעך … פסח מ׳</he> when one old man was crushed to death, and they called it &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 4:3">Tosef. ib. IV, 3</cite> <he>נכנסו ישראל … פסח מ׳</he> the Israelites entered the Temple mount and it could not contain all of them, and they called it &c.; (Var. <he>מוֹעֲכִין</he> the Passover of the crushers; Var. <he>מוכין</he>); Pes. l. c., v. <cite ref="M02073"><he>מְעוּבֶּה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="M02120">same</cite>. Nidd. l. c. <he>מְמַעַכְתּוֹ ברוק וכ׳</he> she tests the nature of the foetus by pressing and rubbing with her nail moistened with spittle. Y. Yoma VIII, 44ᵈ bot. <he>צריך למַעֵךְ את חללה</he> you must squeeze the core of the olive together (to be used as a standard of size).
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 34b:1">Yeb. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>תמר באצבע מִיעֲכָה</he> Tamar destroyed her virginity by friction with her finger; (<cite ref="Yevamot 34b:1">ib.</cite> <he>מוֹעֲכוֹת</he> brides acting like Tamar). Y. Sabb. XX, 17ᶜ bot. <he>מְמַעֵךְ</he> (Bab.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">Esth. R. to I, 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02725"><he>מָרַס</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be crushed, squashed, rubbed off. Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ bot., v. מָסַס. Pes. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:1">Tosef. Mikv. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:14">VII</cite>), 14 <he>והן מִתְמַעֲכִין על הבגדים</he> quot. in R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:2">Mikv. IX, 2</cite> (ed. Zuck. <he>מתמעטין</he>) they are rubbed against (and stick to) the garments, v. <cite ref="C01220"><he>גֵּץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 10:4">Men. X, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 66a:17">66ᵃ</cite>) <he>שלא יִתְמַעֵךְ</he> that its grains may not be crushed; a. e.
